text_block_list.text:
After learning the secrets of leadership from Cesario,
there was a clear change in Fusaichi Pandora.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I've come up with a training menu for ya♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd do my best,
and I somehow got all fired up♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Morning training, afternoon training, and solo training after school.
Though honestly, I'm just an amateur, so I'd like my Trainer to make the final adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Well?
"Just skimming through it, I can tell the workload is several times heavier than before. Adjustments will be necessary, but—I definitely feel your determination!"
choice_data_list: Alright, got it! Let's really give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yup♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Kh, haah, *cough*!
...Gh, phew, whew!!
choice_data_list: ...Pandora, want to take a short break?
...Pandora, want to take a short break?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: N-No, I'm not resting!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, WOOOOOOAHHH!!!
GUTS----!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho!
Is that all for today's batch?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...
I'm gonna swim a bit more before heading back!
This isn't nearly enough for me yet!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...*Pant*, *gasp*!
Urggghhh...! One thousand!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Not yet! Not yet!
Not yet, not yet, not yet, not yeeet~!!
choice_data_list: No, no, break time! Break time!

text_block_list.text: A figure unimaginable from the marshmallow heart she had when she first debuted.
choice_data_list: (Almond Eye, are you focusing on Power...?!)

text_block_list.text:
It seems that Almond Eye is an even greater
source of strength for Fusaichi Pandora
than I had ever imagined.

Perhaps we might see a wonderful result in this Victoria Mile.
One day, while holding such expectations—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Start looks good, time is good,
form is perfect! —All right!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa, that surprised me!
Was that... Heart-chan?

Daring Heart—a bright, energetic Umamusume
fresh back from America who ran the Tiara route
alongside Rhein Kraft's generation.

Furthermore, she is roommates with Fusaichi Pandora,
who will undoubtedly be a formidable rival
in the upcoming Victoria Mile.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
—Oh, my! We're matching.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Matching?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Good work, you two!
Pandora, Heart!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kuu-chan-senpai!
Good work today♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to drop by unannounced. It's not much,
but I brought you two some snacks!
Good luck in the Victoria Mile!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Yay! Thank you! ♡
Wait, why? What's the occasion?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. It's a race with special meaning to me,
so I just felt like doing whatever I could to help!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks! But—
Pandora aside, why did you give one to me too?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Because... Heart-san is my friend too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Hehe!
As cheerful as always, I see!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I have strong feelings for the Victoria Mile, too.
...After all, it's the only GⅠ where I finished ahead of you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Still, even so, it was 6th place. ...In the end, until today,
I haven't been able to hammer out a victory."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
To me, you are still my rival. That is why—
this year, without fail, at the Victoria Mile.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I had intended to give this to you, who showed me only your back
during your first GⅠ victory, but..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Be sure to watch with your own eyes tomorrow!
Craft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. Bringing refreshments was rather thoughtless of me.
To tell the truth, I wish I could've run too, but..."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Right... Kuu-chan-senpai started
going to the hospital right after the Victoria Mile,
didn't she?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (She said it was a 'memorable race' so casually, but there's no way... it's really that simple to her.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Truth is, you want to run yourself...
and win yourself... right?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……Aaargh!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Kuu-chan-senpai!
Gimme some snacks!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
Ah, g-go right ahead—
Pandora grabs the plastic bottle handed to her, and—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Gulp, gulp, gulp... ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Phaaaaaah!!
Aaaah, I'm totally gonna wiiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I'm seriously gonna win, win like the strongest!!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to today, Pandora.
I'm sorry, but I won't let you win.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll win,
and finally surpass that back today...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...—Hey, Heart-chan!
I—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I won the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, you know!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, overall! My track record's pretty solid!
I've done pretty darn well! So what you
really need to look at right now is—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's not Kuu-chan-senpai,
it's me, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm going to beat you—
for Ku-chan-senpai's sake, too!

With the formidable Daring Heart in attendance,
the curtain rose on the Victoria Mile!
